panels.title: DNS Traffic Volume & QPS over Time

targets.query: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(timestamp)) AS time, count() AS Queries, countIf(qr = 1) AS Responses, countIf(rcode = 'NXDOMAIN') AS NXDOMAIN FROM dns_flow.dns_raw WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC
targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(timestamp)) AS time, count() AS Queries, countIf(qr = 1) AS Responses, countIf(rcode = 'NXDOMAIN') AS NXDOMAIN FROM dns_flow.dns_raw WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

targets.query: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(timestamp)) AS time, countIf(is_anomaly = 1) AS Anomalies, countIf(is_malicious = 1) AS Threats, countIf(has(anomaly_types, 'DNS_TUNNELING')) AS Tunneling, countIf(has(anomaly_types, 'NXDOMAIN_FLOOD')) AS NXDOMAIN_Flood FROM dns_flow.dns_raw WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC
targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(timestamp)) AS time, countIf(is_anomaly = 1) AS Anomalies, countIf(is_malicious = 1) AS Threats, countIf(has(anomaly_types, 'DNS_TUNNELING')) AS Tunneling, countIf(has(anomaly_types, 'NXDOMAIN_FLOOD')) AS NXDOMAIN_Flood FROM dns_flow.dns_raw WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

targets.query: SELECT qname, sum(queries) AS total FROM dns_flow.mv_top_domains_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND qname != '.' AND qname != '' GROUP BY qname ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
targets.rawSql: SELECT qname, sum(queries) AS total FROM dns_flow.mv_top_domains_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND qname != '.' AND qname != '' GROUP BY qname ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

targets.query: SELECT concat(query_ip, if(client_city != '', concat(' (', client_city, ')'), '')) AS client, sum(queries) AS total FROM dns_flow.mv_top_clients_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND query_ip NOT IN ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::') GROUP BY client ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(query_ip, if(client_city != '', concat(' (', client_city, ')'), '')) AS client, sum(queries) AS total FROM dns_flow.mv_top_clients_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND query_ip NOT IN ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::') GROUP BY client ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: DNS Record Types Breakdown (QType Distribution MV)

targets.query: SELECT qtype, sum(count) AS total FROM dns_flow.mv_qtype_distribution_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND qtype != '' GROUP BY qtype ORDER BY total DESC
targets.rawSql: SELECT qtype, sum(count) AS total FROM dns_flow.mv_qtype_distribution_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND qtype != '' GROUP BY qtype ORDER BY total DESC

panels.title: Top Resolved Destination ASNs (Answer Dual GeoIP)

targets.query: SELECT answer_asn, count() AS total FROM dns_flow.dns_answers WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND answer_asn != '' AND answer_asn != 'AS0' GROUP BY answer_asn ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
targets.rawSql: SELECT answer_asn, count() AS total FROM dns_flow.dns_answers WHERE timestamp >= $__fromTime AND timestamp <= $__toTime AND answer_asn != '' AND answer_asn != 'AS0' GROUP BY answer_asn ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

targets.query: SELECT query_ip, threat_category, sum(threat_count) AS threats, sum(anomaly_count) AS anomalies, sum(tunneling_count) AS tunneling, sum(flood_count) AS query_floods, sum(nxdomain_count) AS nxdomain_floods FROM dns_flow.mv_dns_abuse_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND query_ip NOT IN ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::') GROUP BY query_ip, threat_category ORDER BY threats DESC, anomalies DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawSql: SELECT query_ip, threat_category, sum(threat_count) AS threats, sum(anomaly_count) AS anomalies, sum(tunneling_count) AS tunneling, sum(flood_count) AS query_floods, sum(nxdomain_count) AS nxdomain_floods FROM dns_flow.mv_dns_abuse_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND query_ip NOT IN ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::') GROUP BY query_ip, threat_category ORDER BY threats DESC, anomalies DESC LIMIT 50

targets.query: SELECT hour, query_ip, client_country, sum(total_anomalies) AS total, sum(tunneling_count) AS tunneling, sum(dga_count) AS dga, sum(nxdomain_flood_count) AS nxdomain_flood, sum(rebinding_count) AS rebinding FROM dns_flow.mv_dns_anomalies_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND query_ip NOT IN ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::') GROUP BY hour, query_ip, client_country ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawSql: SELECT hour, query_ip, client_country, sum(total_anomalies) AS total, sum(tunneling_count) AS tunneling, sum(dga_count) AS dga, sum(nxdomain_flood_count) AS nxdomain_flood, sum(rebinding_count) AS rebinding FROM dns_flow.mv_dns_anomalies_hourly WHERE hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour <= toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND query_ip NOT IN ('0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1', '::') GROUP BY hour, query_ip, client_country ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
